data.name: Session_TakeOverHint
data.value: Stops PrintFlow automation and leaves Meitu as it is, for you to work in. PrintFlow will not force-close Meitu. If Meitu is unresponsive after takeover, close it manually through Meitu or Windows before returning to automation.

data.name: Session_TakingOverNotice
data.value: Handing over — PrintFlow has stopped controlling Meitu and is sending nothing further.

data.name: Session_TakeOverConfirmQuestion
data.value: Take over in Meitu? PrintFlow will stop controlling Meitu for this operation and will send it nothing further. Meitu is left exactly as it is — it is not cancelled and not closed, so it may still be working and you may need to finish or close it yourself. This attempt will not produce a Revision, and returning to automation needs an explicit Return to automation.

data.name: Session_PsdPending
data.value: Original source: PSD (preserved unchanged). Prepare its raster preview before review. Supported: RGB, 8-bit, with a Photoshop-compatible composite. PSD files are treated as visual artwork inputs: existing spot-colour or white-ink channels in the source are not preserved as production channels. PrintFlow generates production white ink when creating the final TIFF.

data.name: Failure_PdfMultiplePages

data.name: Failure_PdfPreparationFailed

data.name: Session_PdfPending
data.value: Source: PDF (unchanged). Prepare its single page at 300 PPI, then review the page and physical dimensions before continuing. Multi-page and encrypted PDFs are unsupported. PDF files are treated as visual artwork inputs: existing spot-colour or white-ink separations in the source are not preserved as production channels. PrintFlow generates production white ink when creating the final TIFF.
